name: B10-0539/2026 (Renew) – Case of Eritrean Swedish journalist Dawit Isaak, arbitrarily detained in Eritrea
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Eritrean-Swedish journalist Dawit Isaak, arbitrarily detained in Eritrea
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for the release of Dawit Isaak, a Swedish-Eritrean journalist held in Eritrea without charge since 2001. It wants Eritrea to say where he is, prove he is alive, and let diplomats, family and lawyers see him. It also asks the European Union to consider sanctions on Eritrean leaders, to tie EU funding to human rights progress, and to push for legal action against those responsible.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament is asking the EU and Eritrea to act; it cannot order either.
- **Who it affects:** Eritrea's president and officials, EU diplomats and funding, and Dawit Isaak and his family.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to EU institutions, Eritrea, the UN and the African Union.
